files.notes: Per-user clone-on-read/write 30-second account-state cache; concurrent probes classify credentials/balance. NT probe omits required NTDataDir before a dormant legacy CSV constructor.
Per-trader charge list and global summary; auth is mounted, but handler and prefix middleware do not enforce ownership here.
Owned TCP-trader maintenance replay and cache/store/replay comparison; independent floor-5m Wilder ATR over common timestamps; response written before backfill send.
Explicit named-contract history-import admin seam; env gate, authenticated route, context forwarding; downstream importer policy outside full read.
Safe presence-flag configuration projections; encrypted/plain update/create; preserve blank credentials, always enabled; reload affected traders; delete refuses bound exchanges.
Global freeze snapshot and trader freeze clear; prefix middleware checks supplied trader ownership.
Recorded CME-day gate/error telemetry; scoped table retains process-wide key, summary remains global.
Owned trader read surfaces via getTraderFromQuery; fills lose ownership at numeric-order lookup; corrected ledger header versus historical raw stats; cutover delegates.

Session/chain/version plan read model, overlays, owner levels, alerts, Q&A/Apply/decline, re-align, approvals/registry, recorded scenario chips. Independent clocks and incomplete transaction scopes are documented in report.
Version+leg+placement ledger selection; separate intended/composed/live accepted quotes, nil on missing/stale/ambiguous snapshot terms.
Legacy force-flat adapter and TCP close submission, then global old kernel PnL reset; count is not broker-confirmed flatness. Risk status exposes decorative env limits and best-effort live metrics.
Read-only stream-idle/outcome table with unresolved bucket and no threshold tuning.
CME-only display-timeframe SVP from shared provider, 2000 named bar-depth constant; empty provider/nonfuture returns empty sessions.
Global token/model/binding settings with masked read, nonblocking reload signal; no per-user ownership or model validation locally.
Compatibility-only trader prompt persistence; competition visibility persists then updates loaded instance.
Single-user-first registration, bcrypt login/password, memory logout revocation; reset triple-gated but delete errors and runtime lifetime gaps remain; defaults seeded transactionally.
Private-key shape and secp256k1 validation, address derivation, public-address balance/health queries, fresh keypair generation response.
Env-only demo switches/canned planner replies and synthetic global futures provider; setup caller must enforce isolation.
32 random bytes hex ticket, 30-second single consumption under mutex, mint sweep; TTL limits redemption, not established SSE lifetime.
Static Go SPA fallback, API exclusion, GET/HEAD only, missing dist nonfatal; boot age from index mtime versus passed binary time.
bcrypt default cost, 24h HMAC JWT claims, shared mutable key, memory blacklist; validation does not itself check blacklist/user existence.
Mutex registry; bound strategy/model/exchange assembly, deterministic legacy provider pick, restart running rows; competition cache with uncancelled timed-out account goroutines.
